outreach.subject: Back-end help for Collabify's first version
outreach.body:
Hi Collabify team,

I saw you're hiring a backend-heavy engineer on contract to own architecture and build the first version of the product. Tenant isolation on a shared Postgres schema with row level security, plus multiple authentication flows, looks like the hard part.

I'm a senior freelance software engineer who builds back-end APIs in Node.js and PHP, working remotely with international companies. I could take on the API and auth layer, or help get the first version out sooner alongside whoever you hire.

Would a short call be useful to see if there's a fit?

Best,
[Your name]
